scope: Historical milestones, not live statistics or promises about future careers. Classroom lessons and questions are editorial interpretation; no player quotation is used. players.name: Bukayo Saka
players.headline: From Hale End to a role model
players.teaser: A young learner became someone the next generation could look up to.
steps: Joined Arsenal’s Hale End academy as a child.
Made his first-team debut at 17 in November 2018.
A penalty was saved in the EURO 2020 final, played in 2021. At EURO 2024 he scored in England’s shoot-out win over Switzerland.
players.lesson: Our team lesson: a difficult moment does not have to be the end of your story.
players.question: What could you say to a teammate who wants to try again?
sources: Arsenal: Saka’s academy journey and milestones

players.name: Max Dowman
players.headline: Small steps. A huge moment.
players.teaser: Years in the academy came before the record-breaking spotlight.
steps: Played for Arsenal’s under-18 team at just 13.
Made his Premier League debut against Leeds in August 2025, aged 15.
Scored against Everton on 14 March 2026, aged 16 years and 73 days—the Premier League’s youngest goalscorer.
players.lesson: Our team lesson: practise your skills and be ready to help when your turn comes.
players.question: What could you practise before your next chance?
sources: Premier League: Dowman’s academy and debut

players.name: Marli Salmon
players.headline: Quiet work. A big opportunity.
players.teaser: A defender’s journey shows that helping the team goes beyond scoring.
steps: Joined Arsenal’s academy at nine in July 2019.
Joined the 2025 pre-season tour and played against AC Milan in Singapore.
Came on against Club Brugge in December 2025, aged 16, for his first competitive senior appearance.
players.lesson: Our team lesson: stay ready, communicate and notice how you can help.
players.question: How can you help a teammate without scoring a goal?
sources: Arsenal: Salmon’s academy journey and debut
